feed.title: NPR Programs: All Things Considered
feed.subtitle: All Things Considered hosts Ailsa Chang, Mary Louise Kelly, Juana Summers and Scott Detrow present the program's trademark mix of news, interviews, commentaries, reviews, and offbeat features 7 days a week.

entry.title: Trump says U.S. has struck a deal for control of Venezuelan oil reserves
entry.summary: President Trump says a new deal with Venezuela would give the U.S. control of more than 65 billion barrels of oil reserves.

entry.title: More school districts are shrinking. New research asks whether closures work
entry.summary: School districts across the country are closing campuses as enrollment falls. New research says the financial savings may be smaller than expected.

entry.title: Getting help to Nepal's flood survivors is proving difficult
entry.summary: Blocked roads and monsoon weather are complicating efforts to get food, shelter and emergency hygeine to survivors of Nepal's catastrophic floods. World Vision's Dhruba Gurmachhan explains what survivors need the most.

entry.title: Rescuers race to find thousands missing after deadly Himalayan floods
entry.summary: Rescue crews are struggling through blocked roads, high mountain canyons and dangerous terrain as they search for thousands of people missing in Nepal and Tibet.

entry.title: What to know about FAA moves to fire two controllers after deadly LaGuardia crash
entry.summary: The FAA's response to a deadly crash is opening a larger debate about staffing, safety and a workplace practice controllers call the "early shove."

entry.title: ICE arrests are surging as the administration targets more immigrants
entry.summary: ICE made nearly 50,000 arrests in July -- the highest monthly total of Trump's second term -- as enforcement expands to more places like airports, courthouses and immigration check-ins.

entry.title: Who gets to be Mary Todd Lincoln next? There's a list
entry.summary: Oh, Mary! has discovered an unusual way to keep a Broadway hit fresh: keep replacing Mary Todd Lincoln with someone completely different.

entry.title: Meta settlement could reshape how social media companies treat young users
entry.summary: Meta agreed to billions in payments and new protections for kids. Harvard Law's Leah Plunkett looks at what it could mean for Meta's competitors and for AI companies.

entry.title: What years covering Puerto Rico reveal about why the taps keep running dry
entry.summary: Puerto Rico's drought is only part of the reason residents are losing water. NPR's Adrian Florido explains what years of reporting on the island have taught him.

entry.title: What makes the Nepal's geography so uniquely prone to disasters
entry.summary: The deadly flooding that struck Nepal this week is not the first disaster that people in the region have endured. The country's unique geography makes it especially prone to natural disasters.
